Axis.description: One axis of the table: a variable and the values it takes.

values.description: Values of the variable, in the variable's units, in the order of the table; at least one.

variable.description:
RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to a decimal input of the inner method, for example
`/discount_rate`.

BaseInput.description: Input of the inner method, exactly as that method accepts it. It is validated by the inner method at run time against its own schema; this schema does not describe it.

base_input.description: Input of that method, complete: the base case.

columns.description:
Optional second variable, along the columns, different from the row variable. Absent:
a one-way table (one column).

method.description: Id of the method to evaluate, for example `dcf.fcff`. Analysis methods are not accepted.

output.description:
RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the decimal output reported in each cell, in the `value` of
the inner result, for example `/enterprise_value`.

rows.description: The variable that changes along the rows, and its values.
